# bs-avatar



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

A circular representation of a person or entity -- a photo, initials, or (as a fallback when
neither is available) a generic user-silhouette icon.

## When to use
- Representing a specific user or account: in a header, a comment, a member list, etc.
- `type="initials"` when a photo isn't available but a name is (e.g. "Sam Lee" -> "SL").
- `type="icon"` (the default) as the generic fallback when neither a photo nor a name/initials
  is available yet.

## When not to use
- A company/brand logo -- use `bs-logo` instead.

This component is decorative/informational by default, not an interactive control -- it renders
a plain `<span>`/`<img>`, not a `<button>`. Figma's own component set includes hover/focused/
pressed states (e.g. for an account-switcher trigger use case), which this implements as real
`:hover`/`:focus-visible`/`:active` CSS on the host itself -- so wrapping this in your own
`<button>`, or setting `tabindex` and a click handler on the `<bs-avatar>` element directly, gets
the matching visual treatment for free with no extra wiring. Left genuinely non-interactive
(no implicit role/tabindex of its own) so it doesn't misrepresent a purely decorative avatar
(e.g. next to a comment) as a control when it isn't one.

## Properties

| Property    | Attribute    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Type                                            | Default  |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `alt`       | `alt`        | `type="image"` only: accessible alt text for the photo, set directly on the real `<img>` this renders -- a person's photo is meaningful content, not decorative, so pass something real (e.g. their name). Falls back to `alt=""` (decorative to assistive tech) when unset, rather than omitting the attribute entirely, but don't rely on that fallback. Ignored for `icon`/`initials` -- see `ariaLabel` for those instead.                                                                                                               | `string`                                        | `null`   |
| `ariaLabel` | `aria-label` | `type="icon"`/`"initials"` only: accessible name for the avatar, set as `aria-label` on the `role="img"` wrapper this renders (neither is a real `<img>`, so there's no native `alt` to set). Setting a plain `aria-label` attribute on the `<bs-avatar>` host does NOT work for this -- that attribute stays on the light-DOM host and never crosses into the shadow DOM, so the actual `role="img"` element stays nameless. Same pattern as `bs-checkbox`'s identical `ariaLabel` prop. Ignored for `image` -- see `alt` for that instead. | `string`                                        | `null`   |
| `disabled`  | `disabled`   | Applies the disabled treatment (50% opacity) and suppresses the hover/focus/pressed CSS states -- this doesn't set a native `disabled` attribute (this component renders no native form control), it's purely a visual/interaction-state flag for when a consuming app has wrapped this in its own disabled control. Reflected so the `:host([disabled])` CSS selector that drives all of the above still matches when a consumer sets the JS property directly (`el.disabled = true`) rather than the HTML attribute.                       | `boolean`                                       | `false`  |
| `initials`  | `initials`   | `type="initials"` only: the initials text to display (e.g. `"SL"` for "Sam Lee"). Ignored for `icon`/`image`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `string`                                        | `null`   |
| `size`      | `size`       | Sizing scale -- `xs` (24px) through `xxl` (128px), matching Figma's own six-step scale.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `"lg" \| "md" \| "sm" \| "xl" \| "xs" \| "xxl"` | `'md'`   |
| `src`       | `src`        | `type="image"` only: the photo URL. This component does not fetch it itself -- network calls, loading/error states, and caching are the consuming app's responsibility, same convention as `bs-logo`'s own `src` prop. Ignored for `icon`/`initials`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `string`                                        | `null`   |
| `type`      | `type`       | What to render inside the circle. `icon` (default) is the generic fallback for when neither a photo nor initials are available yet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `"icon" \| "image" \| "initials"`               | `'icon'` |


## Shadow Parts

| Part          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"container"` | The circular wrapper (all three `type`s render this; `image` additionally wraps a real `<img>` inside it, since the border/background/radius treatment is identical across types and factoring it into one shared part keeps `::part(container)` overrides consistent regardless of which `type` ends up rendering). |
| `"icon"`      | The fallback user-silhouette icon. Only rendered for `type="icon"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `"image"`     | The `<img>` itself. Only rendered for `type="image"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `"initials"`  | The initials text. Only rendered for `type="initials"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| Name                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

| `--bs-avatar-bg-dafault`       | Background, resting. Aliased to --bs-surface-raised. | `--bs-avatar-bg-focused`       | Background while focused. Aliased to --bs-surface-raised, same reasoning as hover.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--bs-avatar-bg-hover`         | Background on hover. Aliased to --bs-surface-raised -- identical to the resting value; only the border recolors on hover (see below).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `--bs-avatar-bg-pressed`       | Background while pressed. Aliased to --bs-surface-raised, same reasoning as hover.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `--bs-avatar-border-focus`     | Focus ring color -- a separate ring drawn just outside the avatar's own border, not the border's own color (see --bs-avatar-border-focused above). Aliased to --bs-border-neutral-focus.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--bs-avatar-border-focused`   | Border color while focused -- Figma keeps this identical to the resting --bs-avatar-border-primary; the focus ring (--bs-avatar-border-focus below) is a separate, additional ring, not a border recolor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `--bs-avatar-border-hover`     | Border color on hover. Aliased to --bs-border-neutral-container-hover.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `--bs-avatar-border-pressed`   | Border color while pressed. Aliased to --bs-border-neutral-container-pressed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--bs-avatar-border-primary`   | Border color, resting. Aliased to --bs-border-neutral-container.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--bs-avatar-border-width`     | Border width at every size except xxl. Aliased to --bs-border-width-thin (1px).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `--bs-avatar-border-width-xxl` | Border width at size="xxl" specifically -- Figma specs this one size a hair thicker (1.333px) than the other five, not a rounding artifact.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--bs-avatar-icon-primary`     | Fallback user-icon color (type="icon"). Aliased to --bs-icon-muted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `--bs-avatar-radius`           | Corner radius -- always a full circle regardless of size. Aliased to --bs-border-radius-full.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--bs-avatar-size-lg`          | Width/height at size="lg". 64px.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| `--bs-avatar-text-default`     | Initials text color (type="initials"). Aliased to --bs-text-default. All of the --bs-avatar-* custom properties above are this library's existing vendored brandsync-tokens tokens (see tokens.css), not new ones invented for this component -- brandsync-tokens already ships a full avatar-specific token set, referenced here directly rather than re-aliased through component-local names the way most other components in this library do, since there's nothing left to add a layer of indirection over. |
